page.overview:
Who is Cubus Sisters?

The initially appear as four young human girls, identical in appearance except for their different colored clothes, who are encountered by Link while he's exploring the . He finds the sister in red cowering in a corner on the first floor while a group of haunt the area. Once the are defeated, she introduces herself to as the youngest daughter of the House of Cubus, having been kidnapped along with her three older sisters and held captive onboard the eerie vessel. She somehow has knowledge of 's name and his quest to rescue , and seems relieved that a hero has arrived to save her siblings as well.

Each of the three remaining can be found in a cell on the three respective floors of the . must free the sisters and lead them one-by-one to where the youngest sister awaits on the top floor. If gets separated by more than a short distance from the girl he's leading, or if a descends into her line of sight, she'll begin to cower in fear and require 's reassurance to continue. When speaking to the , they will occasionally show signs of their true, evil nature, either by giving poor advice, or through a simple slip of the tongue. Once the four girls are reunited, they will gather around and hiss at , sharing disbelief that he survived the and the Ghost 's various traps, and declaring that it's time to "play extra rough". They then transport and themselves to the 's deck and reveal their true forms.

The battle against the takes place across both screens of the Nintendo DS, with the sisters flying around overhead. The youngest sister will launch balls of energy down at in a game of , while the others fire beams of light that must avoid. After outmatching the youngest sister and striking her with her own energy ball twice, she will be defeated and the remaining sisters will continue the battle.

With three or fewer left, the sisters will begin to pass the moving energy ball between themselves several times before returning it to , in an attempt to disorient the hero. The first sister to be struck by the ball twice will be defeated. When two sisters remain, some of the energy balls they launch will be decoys with a different appearance, which will split apart if strikes them with his , likely causing him harm. The final remaining sister will launch three energy balls toward at once; two decoys and one real one. The final sister must be struck three more times before she'll fall, feign congratulations, then disappear, leaving behind the needed to enter the 's hull where is trapped.
